title: parse-capture result
description: v1's minimal shape (#42): find the actionable line as the title, keep the rest as notes. No inferred fields (due date, context, energy, size) -- the sweeper drops those deliberately (docs/sweeper.md) and this skill follows the same posture.

title.description: The actionable line, found in the raw capture text -- never invented, never truncated.

notes.description: Everything else the capture said. Empty string when the whole capture was the title.
